name: Hungry Monkey

rounds.endCondition: After 4 games, or as soon as a player has 10+ beans after a game

categories.label: Beans (total value of Bean cards)
categories.hint: Per game: 1st out draws 2 Bean cards, 2nd out draws 1 (4p: also 3rd gains a 1-bean), last player discards their lowest Bean card. Start with one facedown 1-bean.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: all tied players win.

winCondition: Single game: first player to play all hand and row cards wins; last with cards loses. With bean scoring: most beans after the final scoring (10+ beans after a game or 4 games played).

endCondition.description: Final scoring triggers when any player has 10+ beans after a game, or after 4 games.

notes: family: climbing-shedding. Bean cards are 1, 2 or 3 beans (2/3 cards shuffled facedown), so the scorer enters the total bean value each player holds. 3rd-place bean applies only with 4 players; in 3 players third scores nothing, in 2 players second scores nothing. A loser of the previous game starts the next one.

sources.title: Hungry Monkey rulebook (HeidelBAR Games)
sources.section: p.6 Game End; p.7 Optional Bean Scoring
